# `fixed-asset` commands

## `fixed-asset depreciate`

Post depreciation for every period ending on or before `through` that is not posted yet: debit the depreciation expense account, credit accumulated depreciation. per_period writes one journal entry per period end date; combined writes one dated `through`. Each asset period is linked to its entry, so running again posts nothing twice, and voiding an entry reopens its periods. Dry-run is the preview. A date in a closed period is refused: post it combined into an open period instead. The output names its batch: `batch reverse <batch> --dry-run` previews reversing its journals. Later depreciation batches must reverse first; a live disposal of the asset blocks reversal. Depreciation links remain as history.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/fixed-asset.depreciate` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow fixed-asset depreciate --through 2026-11-30 --reason "Month-end depreciation" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "fixed-asset depreciate", "input": {"through": "2026-11-30"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `through` | `--through` | string | yes | no | — | Post every period ending on or before this date that is not posted yet.; minimum length 10; maximum length 10; pattern "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$" |
| `assets` | `--assets` | array[string] \| null | no | yes | null | Only these fixed-asset items; omitted, every asset set up for depreciation. |
| `entry` | `--entry` | literal["per_period", "combined"] | no | no | "per_period" | per_period: one journal entry per period end date, dated that day, covering every asset due then. combined: one journal entry dated `through` covering every pending period. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Journal memo; omitted, 'Depreciation' with the period. |

## `fixed-asset dispose`

Sell or scrap a fixed asset: one journal entry debiting the net proceeds (proceeds less costs) to `deposit_to`, debiting the accumulated depreciation posted, crediting the asset account with the cost, and the gain (credit) or loss (debit) on the item gain/loss account. Depreciation through the date must be posted first; later periods stop. Marks the item sold or disposed of.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/fixed-asset.dispose` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow fixed-asset dispose "Service truck" --date 2026-12-01 --proceeds 30000.00 --deposit-to Checking --reason "Sold the truck" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "fixed-asset dispose", "input": {"item": "Service truck", "date": "2026-12-01", "proceeds": "30000.00", "deposit_to": "Checking"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |

| `item` | `ITEM` | string | yes | no | — | Fixed-asset item, by id or full name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `date` | `--date` | string | yes | no | — | Date the asset was sold or disposed of.; minimum length 10; maximum length 10; pattern "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$" |

| `deposit_to` | `--deposit-to` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Account the net proceeds go to (a bank account or Undeposited Funds); required when proceeds less costs is not zero. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Journal memo; omitted, 'Disposal of' and the asset. |

## `fixed-asset schedule`

Show a fixed asset depreciation schedule: every period with its dates, amount, the method that gave it, accumulated depreciation and book value, and whether it is posted (with its journal entry), pending or stopped by a disposal. The schedule sums exactly to cost less salvage.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | ledger.read |
| Feature | — |

## `fixed-asset setup`

Set up or change book depreciation on a fixed-asset item: method (straight_line, or declining_balance at 200 or 150 percent of the straight-line rate, switching to straight line when that is larger), salvage value, in-service date (default the purchase date), useful life in months, and month or year periods. Optionally sets the accumulated depreciation, depreciation expense and gain/loss accounts on the item. The cost basis is the item book basis, else its original cost. Returns the schedule. Periods start with the in-service month. Rounding: each period takes its share of what remains above salvage, rounded half to even to the cent, and the last period takes exactly the rest, so the schedule sums to cost less salvage. Tax bases, MACRS and units of production are not computed.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/fixed-asset.setup` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow fixed-asset setup "Service truck" --method declining_balance --declining-percent 200 --salvage 2000.00 --life-months 60 --period year --reason "Book depreciation" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "fixed-asset setup", "input": {"item": "Service truck", "method": "declining_balance", "declining_percent": 200, "salvage": "2000.00", "life_months": 60, "period": "year"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `ITEM` | string | yes | no | — | Fixed-asset item, by id or full name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `method` | `--method` | literal["straight_line", "declining_balance"] \| null | no | yes | null | Book depreciation method. Required the first time; kept when omitted later. |
| `declining_percent` | `--declining-percent` | literal[150, 200] \| null | no | yes | null | Declining-balance rate as a percent of the straight-line rate: 200 (double declining) or 150. Required with declining_balance; it switches to straight line when that is larger. |
| `salvage` | `--salvage` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Salvage value, e.g. 1000.00; the asset is never depreciated below it. Omitted: 0.00 the first time, kept later. |
| `in_service_date` | `--in-service-date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Date placed in service; depreciation starts with its month. Omitted the first time: the item's purchase date. |
| `life_months` | `--life-months` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Useful life in months, e.g. 60. Omitted the first time: the item's useful life. |
| `period` | `--period` | literal["month", "year"] \| null | no | yes | null | Depreciate by the month or by the year (twelve months from the in-service month). Omitted the first time: month. |
| `accumulated_depreciation_account` | `--accumulated-depreciation-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Accumulated depreciation account, set on the item; omitted, the item's. |
| `depreciation_expense_account` | `--depreciation-expense-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Depreciation expense account, set on the item; omitted, the item's. |
| `gain_loss_account` | `--gain-loss-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Gain or loss on disposal account, set on the item; omitted, the item's. |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Version of the setup this change was decided from (fixed-asset schedule). |
